# Liberation Serif regular

Unmodified Liberation Fonts 2.1.5 LiberationSerif-Regular.ttf from the official release:
https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts/files/7261482/liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz
Project: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE.

TTF SHA-256: `058ea80864aef09a23f45cbec2bb5400bc3dfbdea01c3f10538a21fcb497fb74`

font_data.h embeds the exact TTF bytes, without modifying glyphs or font names.
The port uses these embedded bytes, not arbitrary user-supplied fonts. This
portable serif is chosen to match the supplied reference screenshots; it is not
the original Windows GDI font implementation.

Regenerate font_data.h using tools/embed_menu_font.py after updating the font.
